scripts.text:
[Quiver Maker]
You have too many things with you.
Make some space in your inventory and come back. I'll tell you something interesting.
scripts.translation:
[箭袋製作師]
你身上的東西太多了。
請騰出一些背包空間再來找我。我會告訴你一些有趣的事情。

scripts.text:
[Quiver Maker]
You seem worn out with all that stuff.
Make some space in your inventory and come back. I'll tell you something interesting.
scripts.translation:
[箭袋製作師]
看你被這些東西壓得夠嗆的。
請騰出一些背包空間再來找我。我會告訴你一些有趣的事情。

scripts.text:
[Quiver Maker]
Mora villagers ask what good quivers are. They just don't know how the world works.
No wonder they don't know a thing about quivers - spreading jam over leaves all day long.
scripts.translation:
[箭袋製作師]
穆拉村民總問箭袋有什麼用。他們根本不懂這個世界是怎麼運作的。
難怪他們什麼都不懂——整天就知道在葉子上抹果醬。

scripts.text: Please make me a quiver.
scripts.translation: 請給我做一個箭袋

scripts.text: What's a quiver?
scripts.translation: 什麼是箭袋？

scripts.text:
[Quiver Maker]
Finally, someone has appeared who knows the true value of a quiver. I will do it for those who know its worth.
scripts.translation:
[箭袋製作師]
終於有人懂得箭袋的真正價值了。我會為懂得它價值的人制作。

scripts.text:
[Quiver Maker]
At last someone appreciates a quiver!
I can make Elven Quivers and Hunting Quivers.
Which do you need?
scripts.translation:
[箭袋製作師]
終於有人欣賞箭袋了！
我可以製作精靈箭袋和狩獵箭袋。
你需要哪一種？

scripts.text: An Elven Quiver
scripts.translation: 精靈箭袋

scripts.text: A Hunting Quiver
scripts.translation: 狩獵箭袋

scripts.text: I don't need a quiver.
scripts.translation: 我不需要箭袋

scripts.text:
[Quiver Maker]
You can buy arrows off the tool merchant next to me.
scripts.translation:
[箭袋製作師]
你可以從我旁邊的道具商人那裡購買箭矢。

scripts.text:
[Quiver Maker]
I don't sell ordinary arrows. These are artisan arrows that can only be purchased here. Would you really recognize its worth, right?
scripts.translation:
[箭袋製作師]
我不賣普通的箭矢。這些是工匠箭矢，只能在這裡購買。你一定能認出它的價值，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Quiver Maker]
An arrow may be thin and light, but carrying hundreds and thousands of arrows is like carrying a whole log.
scripts.translation:
[箭袋製作師]
一支箭可能又細又輕，但攜帶成百上千支箭矢就像扛著一根原木一樣沉重。

scripts.text:
[Quiver Maker]
But when you have quivers, you can put arrows in them and save weight and space.
If you're interested in one, I'll stitch one up for you.
scripts.translation:
[箭袋製作師]
但有了箭袋，你可以把箭矢放進去，節省重量和空間。
如果你感興趣，我可以為你縫製一個。

scripts.text:
[Quiver Maker]
Bring more than {0} {1} and I'll make you a quiver.
scripts.translation:
[箭袋製作師]
帶上超過{0}個{1}，我就為你製作一個箭袋。

scripts.text:
[Quiver Maker]
Oh, I see you have {0} in your hand!
Are you interested in using a quiver? It's really convenient!
If you're interested, I can trade {1} of those arrows for one of these quivers for ^FF3131{2} zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[箭袋製作師]
哦，我看你手裡拿著{0}！
你對使用箭袋感興趣嗎？它真的很方便！
如果你感興趣，我可以用{1}支箭矢換取一個箭袋，價格為^FF3131{2} Zeny^000000。

scripts.text: Trade all the arrows you have
scripts.translation: 交換你所有的箭矢

scripts.text: Get only one quiver
scripts.translation: 只獲取一個箭袋

scripts.text: Don't trade
scripts.translation: 不交換

scripts.text:
The number of arrows you have : ^3131FF{0}^000000
The number of quivers available : ^3131FF{1}^000000
Zeny needed for trade : ^3131FF{2} zeny^000000
scripts.translation:
你擁有的箭矢數量：^3131FF{0}^000000
可獲得的箭袋數量：^3131FF{1}^000000
交換所需的Zeny：^3131FF{2} Zeny^000000

scripts.text: Trade?
scripts.translation: 交換嗎？

scripts.text: Trade
scripts.translation: 交換

scripts.text: Don't trade
scripts.translation: 不交換

scripts.text:
[Quiver Maker]
Hey, you don't doubt my skills, do you?
scripts.translation:
[箭袋製作師]
嘿，你不會是在懷疑我的手藝吧？

scripts.text:
[Quiver Maker]
Hey, you don't doubt my skills, do you?
scripts.translation:
[箭袋製作師]
嘿，你不會是在懷疑我的手藝吧？

scripts.text:
[Quiver Maker]
I said I'd accept human coins just for you, and you still don't want to spend the money?
scripts.translation:
[箭袋製作師]
我都說了只收你人類的貨幣，你居然還不想花錢？

scripts.text:
[Quiver Maker]
You really don't expect to get your hands on a masterpiece for nothing, do you?
scripts.translation:
[箭袋製作師]
你該不會以為能白拿一件傑作吧？

scripts.text:
[Quiver Maker]
Hey, here you are.
There is ^3131FFsomething you need to know^000000 - try to remember it.
^FF0000You can't use quivers when your encumbrance is over 70%.^000000
You'd better keep that in mind, or you might be in trouble later.
scripts.translation:
[箭袋製作師]
嘿，給你。
有^3131FF一些你需要知道的事情^000000——試著記住它。
^FF0000當你的負重超過70%時，無法使用箭袋。^000000
你最好記住這一點，否則之後可能會遇到麻煩。
